thread:
Maya: Quick sync  thinking about a small-multiples view for route heatmaps + an optional p95 ribbon (not just a single line) so uncertainty is clearer. Sketch: https://redwood-internal.screens/multiples-ribbon.png
Alex: Ribbon sounds promising. FWIW, stacking ribbons across panels might be noisy. What if the ribbon is collapsed to a single line at small widths and expands on hover?
Janet: Accessibility note: ribbons with semi-transparent fills must maintain contrast for the p95 edge. Suggest using patterned fill (diagonal hatch) when contrast gets marginal.
Ravi: UX trade: we need a config for sample-rate display. Proposed phrasing in legend: "sample: 12% (est. p95 variance high)". Keeps users aware of confidence without a modal.
Maya: Timepicker UX: add 5 preset quick ranges (15m, 1h, 6h, 24h, 7d) + keyboard +/- shortcuts to nudge by the current granularity. Also allow alt+click to anchor and drag to extend.
Alex: Copy tweak: change control label "sampling" -> "sampling (data confidence)" and tooltip: "Lower sample rate increases uncertainty in percentiles." Shorter hover: "sample rate affects p95 confidence".
Janet: Contrast/focus nit: legend toggles need 3px focus ring and visible focus text state; screen reader should announce current sample % when toggled. aria-live region ok.
Ravi: Edge-case: for extremely high-throughput routes (>10k rps) the heatmap saturates. Proposal: auto-apply logarithmic color scale with a small legend hint: "log scale applied" and a toggle to force-linear.
DesignBot: Suggested microcopy for low-sample badge: "Low sampling 3% 4 4 increase sampling to improve p95 accuracy" (note: 4 represents spacer).
Maya: Interaction details: when users enable the p95 ribbon, animate its introduction over 300ms and show a one-time helper: "p95 ribbon shows estimated tail and confidence". Don't repeat after it's dismissed.
Alex: Regarding small panels sync: default to per-panel scaling but include a sticky control in the header: "Sync Y" with persisted state per-dashboard.
Janet: Add test cases for keyboard-only users: toggling ribbon, focusing legend, opening time presets, and reading sample badge text with a screen reader. I'll add to the QA checklist.
Ravi: I'll update the figma with the hatch pattern and ribbon states and post a link in this thread when ready. ETA 2pm PT.
Maya: Thanks all 4 will review and leave comments on the figma. :thumbsup:
